author: Brudernatur
quote: I have never experienced such a disappointment. I grew up with the GTA series, and what I’ve been given here is quite simply the biggest scam in the history of humanity. It’s nothing more than a pathetic "simp simulator"—it’s sick. Most of the time, you’re just doing stupid, trivial tasks that have nothing to do with the franchise. This is *The Sims* HD, not *GTA*.
